heritage.jaymoskingdoms.heartlander.gift: Gift: twenty attribute points to put where you like
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.heartlander.desc: Plain folk of the river valleys and the farmland. Nothing in your blood marks you out, so you can become anything.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.stoneborn.gift: Gift: you mine 15% faster, and need no air to breathe
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.stoneborn.desc: Raised under the mountains among picks and lanterns. Stone gives way to you, but you were never built for running.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.tideborn.gift: Gift: long breath, strong swimming, quick mining under water, and blows 15% harder while you're wet
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.tideborn.flaw: Flaw: two minutes out of water and you dry out; then hunger drains 20% faster
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.tideborn.desc: Sea folk from the coves and reefs. The water is home; dry land wears you down until rain or a swim brings you back.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.sylvan.gift: Gift: falls hurt from higher up, and when you sneak, witnesses spot your thieving from less far
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.sylvan.desc: Light-footed woodland kin. You drop from branches without a sound, but you were never one for brute force.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.verdant.gift: Gift: green skin and antennae; you heal on your own, set broken bones, regrow lost limbs; hunger drains 35% slower in the sun; as a Z Fighter, Giant forms and healing others
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.verdant.desc: Of the Verdant blood, like the folk of the Verdant World. The sun feeds you, and fire is your oldest enemy.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.emberborn.gift: Gift: fire, lava and burning never hurt you; hunger drains slower in hot lands; Kindle: hold left mouse bare-handed for a gush of flame from your palm, and let go at full heat to throw a fireball
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.emberborn.flaw: Flaw: the cold (snowy lands, freezing) saps you: 15% weaker blows, 10% slower (twice that when freezing), and hunger drains 25% faster
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.emberborn.desc: Born of the badlands, the deserts and the burning places. Flame and lava cannot touch you, but the frost saps your strength and starves you.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.frostborn.gift: Gift: you never freeze; hunger drains slower in the cold; as a Z Fighter, forms that cost no ki to hold
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.frostborn.flaw: Flaw: hunger drains 25% faster in hot lands
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.frostborn.desc: Your people came from far past the sun, with crafts no Overworld smith has seen, and made their home in the snowfields and the peaks. Powder snow can't touch you, and the heat wears you thin.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.nightborn.gift: Gift: in the dark you hit 10% harder and move 5% faster
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.nightborn.flaw: Flaw: under the open sun you hit 10% lighter
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.nightborn.desc: Your mother's people kept to the night. You come alive after dusk and in deep places, and the daylight dulls you.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.warriorborn.gift: Gift: a tail; below half health your blows land harder the more you bleed (10% to 35%) and you stand your ground; as a Z Fighter, the Great Ape and double growth from defeat; survive near death and gain ten attribute points (once every 5 minutes)
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.warriorborn.flaw: Flaw: you start far weaker than anyone; hunger drains 20% faster, always
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.earthling.gift: Gift: the skill tree learns 25% faster; as a Z Fighter, Training Points 25% faster and a cheaper Limit Break; near death, your ki flares with a random buff for 5 minutes
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.earthling.desc: Plain human blood that makes up for it in grit. Earthlings are born to train: whatever you set your hand to, you learn it fast.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.warriorborn.desc: Of an old fighting blood that came down from the stars. You fight hardest when you're losing, and you're never full for long.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.stormborn.gift: Gift: 12% faster under the open sky; lightning never hurts you, it charges you (Speed II, Strength I); in the rain your blows throw a spark that leaps between two monsters; Thunderclap: hold left mouse bare-handed, let go to call lightning where you look
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.stormborn.flaw: Flaw: deep underground (below Y 0) you're 8% slower
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.stormborn.desc: Your people live on the high peaks where the storms break. The open sky quickens you, and the deep places weigh you down.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.stormborn.hint: Some say it wakes in those whose wind the storm has taken.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.dawnborn.gift: Gift: under the open sun you hit 15% harder and heal; your blows bite the undead 30% harder and set them alight by day; Sunflare: hold left mouse bare-handed by day, let go for a flash that burns the undead, blinds mobs and heals friends
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.dawnborn.flaw: Flaw: in the dark you hit 10% lighter and hunger drains 20% faster
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.dawnborn.desc: Children of the open savanna and the long summer days. The sun is your strength, and the Nightborn have never trusted you.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.endborn.gift: Gift: now and then you blink aside from an arrow or anything thrown
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.endborn.flaw: Flaw: water and rain burn you, a little at a time
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.endborn.desc: Something of the End came back with you. Space folds a little when you need it to, and the rain has never been your friend.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.endborn.hint: Some say it wakes in those who watch the dragon of the End fall.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.dragonblood.gift: Gift: fire and dragon's breath do you half harm; the more gold you carry, the harder you hit (up to 15% with a stack of ingots)
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.dragonblood.flaw: Flaw: carrying no gold at all, you hit 10% lighter
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.dragonblood.desc: Old dragon blood runs hot in you. Flame is a friend, and like any dragon you are only as strong as your hoard.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.dragonblood.hint: Slay a dragon, or win one over, and the blood may answer.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.deepborn.gift: Gift: when you sneak, you sense the creatures round you through stone and walls; sculk never hears you
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.deepborn.flaw: Flaw: blasts stun you for a moment; under the open sun you hit 10% lighter
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.deepborn.desc: You came up from the deep dark changed. You hear the world through the stone, and loud noise and bright sun are hard to bear.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.deepborn.hint: It waits below, with the Warden. Face it, and come back up.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.shunned.1: Shunned: most folk think a little less of Sylvan blood
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.shunned.2: Shunned: most folk look down on Warrior-born blood
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.shunned.3: Shunned: most folk find Stoneborn blood unnatural (worse prices, slower trust, wary guards)
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.shunned.4: Shunned: most folk think Tideborn barely human (worst prices, slowest trust, wary guards)
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.shunned.6: Shunned: every human kingdom finds the Bio-built repulsive, even folk who mind no other blood, and no mask hides it (worst prices, slowest trust, guards on you, townsfolk shrink away; a Bio-built rarely lasts long in a human town)
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.divine.gift: Gift: a halo and gold-touched skin; you mend faster (+1 health every 4 seconds); your blows hit the wicked (the undead, illagers, barbarians, Rogues, the corrupted) 25% harder; healing magic heals 30% more and costs 25% less mana; ki sense and scouters can't find you; you never need food (you can still eat and drink whenever you like, for the pleasure of it) or sleep (no phantoms); as a Z Fighter your ki comes back 25% faster, forms cost 25% less to hold and flight 25% less; while you have feathers a blow or a shot is felt before it lands and slips past you (2 feathers each), and your next blow on whoever threw it hits half again as hard; press Jump again in the air and hold it to drift down; the heritage key lifts you into the light and your feathers come back (sneak and press it for Halo Pulse)
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.divine.desc: Born of the high places, where the light is thick and the old shrines still hum. You are warm to the touch and quick to mend, and the wicked know you for what you are.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.divine.hint: They say it wakes in those who die a second time, among the dead. And in those the Judge lets stay.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.biobuilt.gift: Gift: a made body that grows: press the heritage key on anyone downed or crippled close by (a leg broken or cut off), monster, villager or player, unless they are Dawnborn or Divine, and your tail arcs over your head, swallows them whole and draws them down into you over 5 s (press again, or be hurt, and it lets go), taking a share of their health and their worth; at 16 and at 48 worth (a plain zombie is worth 2) your body remakes itself: the grotesque, tailed Imperfect form, then the towering Semi-Perfect, then the Perfect, the strongest and steadiest (more health, armour and harder blows each time; as a Z Fighter more ki, fists and ki regen, and the Perfect form heals itself with ki); your blows drain 8%, then 12%, then 18% of their harm back as life; every one absorbed stores a charge (up to 4); in the Perfect form press the heritage key (on no one) to bud up to two small copies of yourself that fight for you for 45 seconds, each spending a charge
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.biobuilt.flaw: Flaw: the first form is frail (2 fewer hearts); lightning and magic hurt you 50% more; every human kingdom finds you repulsive, and no mask hides what you are
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.biobuilt.hint: They say the Mad Tinkerer still wanders, and that his work is never quite finished.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.biobuilt.desc: Made by the Mad Tinkerer from the blood of every heritage but the Dawnborn and the Divine, and never quite finished. You were made to become more, and you will, one fallen body at a time.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.rubberfolk.gift: Gift: pink and stretchy: +1 block of reach; lost limbs grow back (one every 20 seconds); press the heritage key on a small weak foe, or any downed one that isn't huge, to swallow it for a heal and take on what it had (half its health, blow and armour, its pace, and fireproofing, water breathing, a soft fall, night eyes or a spring if it had them; only the last thing swallowed, lost on death) (your hand goes to it and it shrinks away over 3 s; press again, or be hurt, and it stops); its body stays in you, and sneak + the heritage key pukes it back up under a mound of pink that melts away (and what you took from it goes with it); a downed player you swallow stays alive inside you, wounded, and can fight their way out by hitting your heart, lungs and stomach, or be digested if they go down in there; cookies, pie, honey, berries, melon and cake mend 2 hearts, Kitchen's tarts, pies and brownies 3; as a Z Fighter blows bounce off you (25% less from melee hits, half from falls) and your fists snap back 1.5 harder
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.rubberfolk.flaw: Flaw: fire burns you 60% longer; arrows and spines hurt you 25% more
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.rubberfolk.desc: Soft, bright and bendy, born at the fairs where the strangest folk gather. You take a knock and bounce, grow back what's lost, and never turn down a cake.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.flaw: Flaw: no realm will have one of them
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.desc: Short, green and warty, all ears and nose, born only to their own in the goblin villages. Greedy, sly, and never far from someone else's gold.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.orc.gift: Gift: bigger and broader than any man
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.orc.flaw: Flaw: no realm will have one of them
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.orc.desc: Grey-green, tusked and scarred, born only to their own in the orc war camps. They live for the fight, and fight harder the more they bleed.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.beastfolk.gift: Gift: the wild's senses: ears that turn to every sound, a tail, and eyes that shine in the dark; born one of six kinds of beast (spider, bird, hound, cat, fox or snake) or plain Tawny, and each kind has its own ability, gift and flaw
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.beastfolk.flaw: Flaw: the beast always shows: every kind has a weakness of its own, and no hat hides the ears
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.beastfolk.desc: Born in a den in the wild lands, in fur, feather or scale. The beast in you makes you quick and keen, and the towns have never let you forget it.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.hollow.gift: Gift: death has had you once and let you go; you rise plain Pallid or as one of four kinds of dead (zombie, skeleton, wraith or reaper), and each kind has its own ability, gift and flaw
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.hollow.flaw: Flaw: the grave's cold stays in you: every kind has a weakness of its own, and the living know you on sight
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.hollow.desc: You were struck down by the dead and got up again. Something of the grave came back with you, and folk can tell.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.hollow.hint: Those the dead cut down do not always stay down.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.shunned.beastfol: Shunned: most folk keep a wary eye on Beastfolk blood (worse prices, slower trust)
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.shunned.hollow: Shunned: most folk will not have the Hollow near them (worst prices, slowest trust, wary guards)
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.dragonblood.gift: Gift: the more gold you carry, the harder you hit (up to 15% with a stack of ingots)
